thread:
Lena (Procurement): QuotaSage sent a renewal with an unusual anchoring and 'smoothing' clause. Need quick eyeballs before I reply.

Omar (Finance): Paste the clauses?

Lena (Procurement): Copy from quote: `Anchoring_credit = min(0.2*commit, 45000) applied at signing; Provider may perform usage smoothing +/-15% months 2-4 to align with commit.` Also they list ingest at $110/GB with a note 'ingest excludes cached KV traffic'. Link: https://qsage.example.com/quote/RED-3030.pdf

Priya (Eng-ML): Sounds similar to other quotes but that smoothing is dangerous for bursty workloads. We have selective cache spikes. Confirm how they detect "cached KV traffic" — need explicit exclusion for internal KV hits.

Diego (Legal): We should request: 1) no retroactive billing adjustments for pilot months; 2) daily usage CSV export and API access; 3) 60-day dispute window.

billing-bot: Estimate created: QS-3030-estimate $29,100/mo at commit. https://billing.redwood/estimates/QS-3030

Omar (Finance): Anchoring cap at 45k is big. For a 3-month pilot that's maybe the whole pilot. Ask for anchor to vest monthly or be refundable on termination. Also prefer $ cap on smoothing rather than percent.

Lena (Procurement): Draft counter bullets: - Remove smoothing for pilot months 1-3; - Cap any post-hoc adjustment to $12,000/month; - Anchor vests over 3 months and refundable if we terminate for convenience; - Explicit token definition (are embeddings counted?); - KV cache egress excluded; - Provide sample billing tables for 60/100/200% of commit.

Priya (Eng-ML): Add: clarify quantization requirement — if they require it, ask for supported formats (int8/4), expected latency delta, and whether model outputs change. Also request that embeddings be billed at a different SKU or exempt for pilot.

Diego (Legal): I'll add: no clawbacks more than 30 days after invoice; any reconciliation must be accompanied by raw usage data and be disputable. Also audit rights once per year.

Omar (Finance): Also ask them to break out network/compute/model charges on invoices for mapping to our cost centers.

Lena (Procurement): I'll send this counter now and cc procurement list. If they push smoothing, we insist on dollar cap and require escrowed credits to cover any retro adjustment.

Priya (Eng-ML): Happy to review vendor's tech annex when they respond.

Lena (Procurement): Draft sent. I'll paste vendor reply in thread when it arrives.
